settings.heading: The products we stand behind
settings.lead: Small batches, named materials, and a repair or refund if one of them lets you down.

settings.heading: Why we keep the range small
settings.text: Most online shops sell thousands of things. We sell a handful. That is not modesty; it is the whole idea. Every piece here had to earn its place. It has to solve something small you deal with every day, and still be worth having a year from now. Most things we look at do not make the cut. We are a small business, not a warehouse. If something we sell does not hold up, we want to hear
settings.image_note: Still life — linen, ceramic and wood on a wooden table, natural light

settings.heading: One letter a month
settings.text: New pieces, restocks, and what we learned about the makers. No more than twelve emails a year, and you can leave in one click.
